title: CalcPuter
summary: Engineering calculator: functions, variables, calculus and graphs
description:
CalcPuter is a keyboard-first engineering calculator for the CardputerZero.

- Expressions with implicit multiplication (2pi, 3(x+1)), hex/binary literals, n!, DEG/RAD trig, logs, gcd/lcm, nCr/nPr and more
- Variables and your own functions: r = 4.7e3, f(x) = x^3 - 2x
- Calculus: der(f(x), 2), integ(sin(x), 0, pi), solve(x^2-2, 1), sum(1/x^2, 1, 100)
- Fast input: Space completes names (sq -> sqrt()), automatic paired parentheses, a leading operator continues from ans
- Graphs of up to four functions with pan/zoom, trace with y and y', root and min/max search
- AUTO/SCI/ENG number formats, dark and light theme; history, variables, functions and plots are kept between runs

Tab switches CALC / Y= / GRAPH, Fn+H shows help for the current page.
